_metadata.description: Object removal always has a working provider: a standalone builtin mask_fill for flat/smooth backgrounds, with iopaint provisioned through a governed host-tool installer for the quality path.

requirements.title: builtin mask_fill provider
requirements.description: mask_fill dilates the mask, grows it over connected pixels differing from a local background estimate beyond halo_threshold, solves the Laplace equation inside the grown mask, and composites the result. It is registered as a standalone builtin provider ranked below iopaint.

validation.notes: api/internal/ai maskfill unit tests + pointer-fixture regression; live removal matches a0-clean (SSIM 0.9997).

requirements.title: Governed iopaint provisioning
requirements.description: iopaint gains a governed installer handler (uv tool install, pinned, into ~/.vrooli) and is declared in image-tools hostTools[] as optional, with the backends matrix regenerated.

validation.notes: iopaint remains a manual host tool (vrooli host install iopaint reports manual_action_required); mask_fill covers the always-available path.
